# Upscaled

> Web design studio in London, designing and building custom websites for small businesses.

## Who we are
Upscaled is run by Raffaele and Brilliana from London, working with small businesses across the UK.

## What you get
- Custom design, with no templates
- Easy for your customers to get in touch
- SEO meta tags
- Google search visibility
- Analytics
- AI services (optional extra)

## How it works
1. Call: we talk about your business, your customers and what the site needs to do.
2. Design: we design your homepage first and refine it with you.
3. Build: we build the other pages, add your content and test on phones and desktops.
4. Launch: we put your site live, check that everything works, then keep it maintained.

## Maintenance
We maintain the websites we build after they launch.

## Quotes and payment
We send a written quote for each project. Payment is a 50% deposit, then the balance at launch.

## Audits
Website audits are a paid service.
